sources.title: GEMMA-SQL: A Novel Text-to-SQL Model Based on Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Text-to-SQL systems enable users to interact with structured databases using natural language, eliminating the need for specialized programming knowledge. In this work, we introduce GEMMA-SQL, a lightweight and efficient text-to-SQL model built upon the open-source Gemma 2B architecture.

sources.title: GEMMA-SQL: A Novel Text-to-SQL Model Based on Large Language Models
sources.snippet: Key Contributions The key contribution is a resource-efficient and high-performing text-to-SQL model, GEMMA-SQL, which leverages prompting strategies and instruction tuning to outperform existing baselines on the SPIDER benchmark.

sources.snippet: GEMMA-SQL is an advanced Text-to-SQL model leveraging large language models to translate natural language queries into accurate SQL statements. It introduces a guided decoding mechanism and schema-aware prompting to enhance performance.
